There have been more and more cars in Anchor City. It was okay like, maybe 10 years ago, but they're all over the place these days!
It's too much...
Sigh. I feel stir-crazy when I hole up at home, but I feel so overwhelmed when I'm out.
Now what?!
I gotta stop all my streaming services... I never watch anything more. I'm learning that I rather be out and about seeing the sights.
Argh, but I've got family and friends leeching on to my accounts...
Hey, back it up a little... I haven't done anything wrong...
Huh? You're not in trouble. I'm just saying hi...
Oh. Okay... Well, hi, then.
Uhhh, hey, dude.
...What's up, man?
Damn. Running out of cigarettes. Again... Ugh.
Smoking's bad...
Ooh, try the convenience store!
Yeah, man. They're a money sink, they make me stink,  I'm quite sure it's making my chest ache.
Oh. It makes me shit too.
Why...why are you doing it, then...
I'm used to paying big price for a small reward.
Oh. Yeah. Thanks. I never knew I could do that. Have only been smoking for over a decade...
Heh. You're such an odd guy...
So many people in Anchor City always...running here and there. Chasing after something.
I get exhausted just watching them.
I can't deal with the constant noise in the city. Could never leave my apartment without my earbuds...
Ugh. I hate how chilly I can get. Such a pain needing to bundle up all the time.
It's Summer..!
You look cool, though?
I...yeah, I know. I just...suck, man.
...Thanks, I guess.
Looking "cool" isn't exactly a priority in my life, though.
They've been doing a lot of renovation work in Uptown, right? I think they should set up a whole bunch of casinos.
I love a slot machine...
I swear...I'm gonna choke my boss out if my latest cheque bounces again.
...Relax. I meant in my head.
I'm just excited to get home and tear open a bag of chips.
Gods. Saying it out loud made me realize just how pathetic that is.
Hey! No, no, it's little joys. Not pathetic!
...Okay. Little joys. I like that.
I'll bump some albums too. Little joys. Heh.
Wonder if there's a game on tonight...
I don't relly care; it's fun to jeer at the Saints, haha.
I kinda hate those giant billboards with those bright, flashing images...
Why?
Oh, I love those. They're so fun!
Oh... I kinda get it.
I don't. Really know.
They just kinda freak me out. It's stupid, I know.
Yeah, I'm sure most people do...
Do you? It's not because I hate consumerism or whatever.
Like...I feel anxious when I look at 'em. And...distressed? When the image changes? All this and I can't resist looking away too.
I don't know. It's kinda weird,
I should be glad I've got a good metabolism. I'm just constantly snacking on something whenever I head...anywhere in this city.
I'd hate needing to upsize my entire wardrobe.
I should hit up some of my buddies tonight... Gotta rant about work.
I'm mostly ears! Rant to me! To me!
That's a good idea.
Hmm... No, I can't. Not to you.
It's funny. Sometimes, something super shitty happens to me, and mentally I'm just thinking, "Holy shit. I can't wait to bitch about this later with the bros."
Hmm. Okay, I guess you're cool.
It's just...my boss is riding me hard to flip our shit on these dumb school kids. It feels bad.
I'm...scamming teenagers into buying stolen shoes. At ridiculous prices. It sucks.
Oh... That is... Oh...
I know. I gotta find a different gig some time. This crap just doesn't feel good.
I gotta find a bigger apartment so I can finally get on that...
Get on what?
Shit. You heard that? I don't realize how loud I'm mumbling to myself when I've got my earbuds on sometimes...
Anyway...it's nothing. I'm just talking idle nonsense. Don't mind me.
Oop. You heard?
Uh. I was just fantasizing about how I wanna do up my living room...
A full vintage stereo hifi audio setup...a preamp with the tubes, reel to reel tape players, ugh, and those Elite Harmonix speakers?
Why use old stuff for your setup? Wouldn't new stuff be better?
Ooh... Sounds fancy.
Yeah. I'm a little bit of an audiophile...
Haha, there's plenty of appeal in vintage sound systems!
Older stuff were made out of much better materials and with meticulous craftsmanship. The produced sounds end up much warmer and richer.
Plus they're hella durable too. And they look pretty cool too, as a bonus.
I respect the grind.
I loathe the grind...
Sometimes it feels like I'm just waiting for my phone to light up so I have something to do...
...Don't judge the games I'm playing.
What ARE you playing? I just see flashing lights.
...It's just a stupid casino app. I know it's absurd, and I know they're exploiting my vulnerabilities- but it's whatever, man!
YES! Jackpot!
Uh. Don't mind me.
I actually like travelling. It's chill, just sitting and listening to music.
The view's pretty nice... Especially paired with music.
I could stay in the carriage forever, honestly.
The trains are always so damn loud. I hate that the tracks snake through severel sections of the city, too.
A house full of lame sticklers...
I've got a lotta memories in Droptown...
Good ones?
Hmm. Yeah. More good than bad.
Droptown is an okay place for a kid to grow. No matter what some people say.
This view...it's kinda whatever. It's just a buncha buildings and stuff...
The capsule hotel is an...okay place to crash at. If you don't mind hearing weird noises at night.
Snores. I meant snores. Not...the worst, but still pretty annoying.
This apartment building is overrated. Way too pricey. And you can't make any real changes to them.
A fancy gilded cage, if you ask me.
I wouldn't shop here. Everything's marked up...
Ugh... I know. Ironic for the flipper to say.
I had friends who used to shred on these steps with their skateboards...but you get fined for skating around here these days.
Damn, these rugs are the fancy, artsy kind.
I think...I'll take my business elsewhere.
Wine people are so full of crap, with all their weird rituals.
It's dumb. I rather have soju.
The vanilla ice cream is great. Hear me out- I know it's the boring flavor, but theirs is really, really good.
This store knows what's up.
They just know what's up.
Sending handwritten mail feels...archaic. And pointless.
Sure, I know people are gonna romanticize the shit out of it but...it just involves way too much labor for something you could just do digitally with zero effort. From anyone!
This bubble tea chain's the only one that has flavors I actually like...
People are willing to pay a stupid, stupid amount for some sneakers...
Walking by here can be a little stressful...
Act natural!
I just end up freezing up whenever someone says that...

I learnt in Social Studies that the people here come from all kinds of places. What was the word they used…oh! Melting pot!
Anchor City is one big, delicious melting pot of people!
That sounds terrifying. Like you're cooking them...
Oh ew, people soup…
One of my classmates live in one of those super fancy apartments in the high-rises…
Wonder what it's like. Must be like you're living in the clouds.

Aww, but that's when AC's the most pretty! The lights from all the signs and cars make it look like a sea of stars.
There's always construction work happening somewhere in the city.
I hate it. It's so noisy.

Really? I would have thought it'd be blue.

Being the youngest sibling sucks... You never get anything new, ever.
Thank you! You can buy all the red scarves you want one day, when you're older!
It's okay, little dude! Blue is way cooler a color anyway!
Hmm...you're right!
I always thought the blue Anima Ranger is cooler than the red one!
Pfft. No way. If I was an adult with money, I'd make a giant race track made of candy.
I'm excited to get home for dinner!
It's microwave dinner night! Microwave dinner! Microwave dinner!
You're excited about microwave dinner..?
Yeah. Frozen meals go pretty hard these days.
Yup, yup! It's tastier than anything my parents ever cook.
My parents are not good at cooking...
Duhh, of course they're hard- they're freezed! Everyone knows that!
Oh...wait. You're a farmer, so maybe that's why you're confused.
Oh my gosh! You're going to have your mind blown if you hear about the microwave next!

Ohh... I'm sorry, mister. I didn't think they have microwaves in farm villages...

Duh, I'm nott. I know what budgeting is.

Not the old Carrot Gear cartridges in the bins. They're cheaper than the bubble tea drinks my sister is always buying...
My mom doesn't like it when I'm always hanging out at my friend's homes.
But going home immediately after school sucks! I always have to wait my turn to use the computer.
And my brother's always using the computer longer than he's supposed to.
I don't get how there's all this good food all over the city but then the stuff in the school canteen is all gross and sad.
Why are they always building new things for Uptown? Shouldn't they be donig that to Droptown instead?
You have to be super, super rich to be able to buy a car, right?
That means we have a lotta super, super rich people in Anchor City...
I wonder what snow is like. I always see it in the cartoons and it looks super fun...
I wish it snowed in Anchor City...
Oh, it's Oli! He's my classmate!
His family is super rich. They have a car.
Oli's always playing at the arcade 'cuz his parents got him a gold membership card for his birthday...
Way cooler than the birthday card I always get.
It's the thought that counts!
Everyone always says that...
Trains are so cool... I only ever get to sit on them when we're visiting our cousins.
This building looks important...and boring.
Even boring-er than school!
The mall is cool... Everyone's always so happy here.
Ahhh... It's so nice and cool in here!
I don't get rugs. They're ugly and smell funny.
My brother let me try wine once. It was so freaking gross.
But my friend told me that it'll taste better when you get older!
Wait. Or was it that it tasted better if the wine itself got older? Eh, I forgot.
The ice cream here is so nice!
My dad buys me a triple scoop cone when I do well in my exams!
My mom says this jewelry stuff is a scam.
But she still stares at the display necklaces everytime we walk past it anyway...
The food in this restaurant doesn't seem like it's nice...the people inside always look so serious and unhappy.
I rather eat at the fast food places in Droptown!
Bubble tea! My sister's always buying this stuff.
Which is awesome, 'cuz she always gets me a vanilla milkshake when she does!
These shoes look so funny. Like clown shoes.
Coffee's gross...but I think it smells nice.

I gotta go!
Wow, you again... That's craaazy.
You again?

Every corner I take there's always the smell of food.
Okay, uhm. I gotta go now.
Bye, weirdo...

I'm pretty sure it's not happening that soon...
Oh, is that so?
Well, why was I so worried then? I'm gonna develop wrinkles from all this unnecessary stress!

Oh, cool. So do you know about...that building over there?
Uhhh, I said my parents were into it, not me!
That just looks like any ol' building.
Oh! Actually, they sell some pretty good waffles there.
I love food. And the food in AC is truly exceptional!
You know, Anchor-style food? The locals really weren't kidding when they say they've mastered the art of blending flavors and cuisines.
Only problem is that it's a little...on the pricey side.
Ughhh, I gotta ask my mom to up my allowance sometime.
My classmates are wild... They're always up to something after school...karaoke, billiards, cafe-hopping.
They invited me to an 'escape room' the other day and I declined them because...what the heck is that anyway?!
It's a little sad Anchor City doesn't really have seasons. I low-key miss them...
I'm at least a little thankful for the nice weather we get year-round. Though the air's a little...how do I put it...it's a little thick here?
There's always so much to do in Anchor City! I don't think I could ever get bored here!
Hiii, farmer guy!
There's always so much to do in Anchor City! I don't think I could ever get bored here!
Could I ask you something, mister?
Yees?
Do you think my bow barrett looks...silly? Like, duh, I know it's super cute and all but...
I'm not too old for it, am I? Iit's just- this classmate of mine keeps saying it's for lame toddlers...and I-

...Okay, I'll keep it on! Thanks.

...Okay, I'll keep it on! Thanks.

Scarf looks good today!
I'm thinking I should get a bow barrett the same shade of red!

I have a feeling they made a new one without me...
...Yes?

Huh?

I just wanted to befriend you..?
...Yeah, no thanks to that too!
Hey, li'l guy.
I'm quite sure I'm older than you are...
Yeah? You're also little-er than I am.
Sigh. Hello, overly friendly guy.
Hello. Y'know, I'm starting to not mind bumping into you.
Hello...friend!
Oh, we're friends? Officially? Should we exchange names, finally?
We're not that close.

I'd almost prefer spending my time in Droptown if it wasn't so...happening. And if it wasn't so easy to get lost there, too!
Uptown, Droptown. Yuppies, Doonies. Always with the butting of heads and petty quarrels.
The sky goes down the same in either districts.
I think I've gotten way too comfortable paying exorbitant fees when I eat out...
It's okay, you deserve a nice treat!
Yeah, but I don't deserve it that often.
I saw a crazy line the other day. I'm talking a several blocks, bending-around-corners, traffic hazard line.
The line turned out to just be sneakerheads trying to cop an exclusive pair of shoes.
A collab with a local artist. It's exceedingly stupid!
My friends are always ragging on me for always sporting designer goods and... Is it really my fault designer goods tend to look good and be of good quality?
The other day...some flash mob was happening and it was gods awful.
Fun! What was it for?
Hells if I know. I left immediately.
I don't get why people would ever complain about there being "too many coffee places in AC."
Coffee's great. Caffeine is GREAT. I think I drink more coffee than water.
Okay, that's enough talking. You're kinda overstepping boundaries.
I love me a breakfast sandwich. It's the optimal meal, anytime of day.

They have an almond butter station- it's crazy. I'm obssessed.

Quality and curating your lifestyle comes at a price.
I'm always seeing starry-eyed tourists stepping off the train station screaming and being a nuisance.
Anchor City isn't all that. I hope they have the worst time here.
And if I see another selfiestick I'm snapping that shit in half.
Uhm...
You're such a wet blanket...
Yeah, I am!
I'm a professional hater.
Yeah, yeah! I'm talking about you.
Consider it a warning!
...You wanna guess what I have in my bag?
You whip that thing out and I'mma do exactly as I said!
I'm sick of seeing tourists all over the place.
At least they don't generally go to Droptown.
Oh my GODS, why is that guy here?
Oh. That guy! Probably going around the city to get his blood pumping.
Let me guess...you hate him!
DUH. Of course he is. That is the exact kind of pretension he'd talk about 'walking' with.

Oh, I don't just hate him. I hate everything, but he hates that I hate things. And I hate that he hates that I hate? And he'd hate that I hate that too?! And it's all one big whirlpool or loathing and disdain!!!
...Anyways. All this to say: don't go on blind dates your friends set up for you.
Ah. Hello.
Hi! I'm Tsuki! Farmer from Mushroom Village!
Ah, okay. Hello.
...Yeah, I'm gonna go now.
Ah, okay.
Hello.
Hi, there.
Mm. How exciting..!
Ah, you wish to speak with me? Again?

Ah. I just completed today's crossword puzzle.
It's such a special feeling to have solved it on your own!
I should head back soon. I must water my plants.
Your plants will be fine even if you water it a little than usual..
Ah...I don't know. I don't like breaking routine.
What a day! Plenty of work was done today.
I think I'll allow myself a treat.
Ooh. What's the plan?
Perhaps I'll have myself some crackers before bed time.
Yes, yes... That sounds delightful.
Oh. That's kinda underwhelming. What flavor?
Unsalted.
Augh...oh, my... You're probably dunking it in something right?
Ah. No?
That would compromise the neutrality of its flavor.
Yesss! Treat yourself!
Yes, indeed!
Mmm. My laundry needs tending to today.
I do not understand why people dread doing it. I find joy in organizing my clothes after having them washed.
My favorite is having to match the socks with another...
Ah, what an ordeal. There are just too many streaming services nowadays.
I miss when television was uncomplicated. I used to catch my shows on a single channel.
What, the infomercial channel?
Oh, no. That's boring.
It was DocuSphere. They aired documentaries all day. I especially enjoy the ones where they show how things are made.
So interesting!
Off to work. I'm quite looking forward to it.
What do you do?
Financial analysis! It's thrilling.
I use spreadsheets to solve most of my problems. I understand it may be...odd to some, but it scratches an itch.
Organizing copious amounts of data into orderly columns, automating calculations with meticulously crafted formulae...ah, and formatting.
Formatting...
You have mentioned that you came from elsewhere...Mushroom Village, was it?
I do not travel beyond my domicile often. It is...intimidating.
But I do have a fond memory of travelling to other nations as a child. I could never forget the crinkle of frosted grass beneath my feet.
I had a thought provoking realization the other day.
Do share.
We do not really have dictionaries around anymore. I miss them a great deal.
We...have dictionaries. They're so easy to access now. It's in my phone.
Oh, I'm sure.
Sheer brilliance strikes me whenever I contemplate in the shower...
That's what I mean! Those are not the same as a physical dictionary.
Used to be: I would encounter a word I know not the meaning of. I would then have to crack open the dictionary.
The search is half the fun. I love stumbling through the pages and learning about other words too.
I enjoy seeing you in my walks.
Like a breath of fresh air. I find other Anchorites so intense.
They are so...stressed out all the time. Like a powder keg about to explode.
Anchorites certainly need to learn to find little pockets of joy in their lives.
Don't you agree?
Ah...I think I'm all talked-out. Let's pick this up next time.
What a thrill, what a thrill. I left the house today without my umbrella. Was nearly late for work and I chose not to search for it.
Is that really something you consider a thrill?
I have my moments of reckless risk-taking!
Just the other day, I removed my flash drive without safely ejecting it first!
Hi, again.
It's talkative rabbit guy! Hey, you.
What a beautiful day to be out...
Everyday here is inspiring.
I know many people are opposed to the swathes of change that have been coming Uptown's way, but there's no denying most people would rather be here than in Droptown.
I go exploring in Droptown sometimes, if I'm feeling especially bold that day.
I love the buzz. I love the quirky, little indie shops. It's just...
I don't know, it can be a little unsafe there sometimes. Especially so for a little guy like me...
Let's wrap this little tete-a-tete up. I've got places to be.
Toodles! Maybe we can talk again some other time!
Ah, it's a shame. The yuppies strike again!
What happened?
This street here used to hold these big bonanza of a block party, but some folk voted against it.
And here I was hoping to sell some of my crotcheted goods at a flea market...
Mmm. Could go for a bite.
Never have I seen a city so enamored with the concept of brunch.
What IS brunch, anyway?!
A late breakfast, an early lunch, a combination of the two.
But really it's just an excuse to have mimosas if you ask me.
Oh, I have a great idea for a future crocheting project!
Crocheting? That's like knitting, right?
Do tell!
Pyjamas! For candles!
Yes, but not really. Different tools are used for either activity: a single hook for crocheting and two needles for knitting.
That's the main difference, but the resulting fabrics are worlds apart in terms of texture.
Personally, I prefer the thicker fabric and style of crocheted goods. Plus it's much simpler in terms production- much quicker too.
Sounds a little...impractical.
I know, haha. But crocheting isn't all about functionality to me. It's an art!
And art is all about the joy of creating.
The shopping mall always smells so nice...
I prefer doing my shopping not at the mall...everything there has its prices so hiked up.
Not a big fan of those fancy boutiques. I like buying from indie creators! Online, mostly.
It's motivated to create for myself, too. Like this hat!
Hello! Can I...help you?
No! I'm just saying hi! I'm Tsuki, a farmer from Mushroom Village.
Oh, how unusual! Do you always walk up to people and introduce yourself like that?
Hello, there, buddy! You look new.
I am! I'm visiting from Mushroom Village. Hi!
Ahhh, I knew it! Call it a mall cop sense.
Anyway, if you need help navigating the mall- I'm your guy!
Oh, and if you see ANY manner of shenanigan, let me know!
Welcome, welcome!
Heyo, welcome to the mall!
Hello! Welcome to the-
Oh, wait. We aren't in the mall right now...
Hello, there!
I'm watching you!
Wuh? I'm not doing anything wrong!
I know, I know! I should rephrase that; I'm watching you- out of care!
This is the best job ever. I'll never get sick of patrolling the mall!
I get to window shop on the job..!
You sure you're staying vigilant?
I can do both, okay!
I looove the mall playlist. It's so upbeat!
Puts a spring in my step.
Fear the prancing mall cop..!
I'll have you know I can skip at incredible speeds!

What kid wouldn't want to work in the mall?!
What kid would want to work?
Oh, it isn't too bad once you got your cash...
It's a magical, formative moment for a wee kid. Getting their first payout...
You really are...such a mall guy.
Heheh. Yeah, I'm very much a 'mall guy'.
This mall has gotta be...one of the best malls in the world. I mean- we've got a skytower and everything!
The mall floors are so squeaky clean... Thank goodness for our janitors!
Agh, it's so hot outside the mall. I'm sweating in my uniform.
Is it crazy that I wanna head to the mall even after my work hours..?
A little...yeah.
Well, aren't you honest.
Hey, I just wanna dip into the game store to pick up my pre-order, okay?
I can't do that while I'm working...
Gotta keep an eye on those teens. They're at an age where they don't think before they act- and they're always acting to impress someone.
What have teens done to you?

I had to work past my shift to sort that whole mess out with the firefighters...
With each promotion I get as a mall cop, they give me more tools to attach to my belt.
It's cool. Or at least I think so... Even if it's heavy and snagging on everything. Not to mention the chafing...
What's in your loadout, cowboy?
Heavy is the hip that wears the mall cop belt...
'Loadout', huh? You're making it sound a lot cooler than it actually is.
Buuut, let's see...
I've got two flashlights, pepper spray, some zipcuffs, pair of handcuffs, big thing of keys, baton, my secret box of things, and my fanny pack.
Yeah. Gets heavier the more important I get.
I hear from my roommate it's the opposite for policemen. Having nothing on your belt means you've truly made it.
Whatever that means... Different food chains, eh?
Sounds like you're better off with a backpack.
What's in your secret box of things...
Well, if I told you it wouldn't be a secret anymore...
It's just gummies. Like, a lot, a LOT of gummies.
The sugar rush gets me going, okay?
Hah! Like yours?
I wouldn't look very intimidating...
I'm just going somewhere close-by. Don't question why I'm still in my uniform.
This is a fancy train carriage...
I mean- they're got a train butler. That's ridiculous..!
Nice and chilly...
Like the mall!
Like the mall...
Walking by the station is kinda like a reminder that I need to go visit my parents some time...
Wonder if they've got a food court in City Hall.
What? Is it a weird thing to ponder? I mean...the people in there have got to eat too.
One time, they were doing maintenance work on these escalators, early in the morning when I was on the way to work.
It was hell, man. It was hell...
I get to come up the sky tower for free. It's pretty sweet.
Quite the view, quite the view...
There were a few nights where I had to stay at this hotel.
It's cool in concept. But I'm way too big for the capsules.
Woke up with a neck cramp.
The receptionist here once got mad at me for taking shelter from the rain in here.
These rock statue...thingies were kind of new addition to the mall entrance.
Always felt like they were a waste of space.
Oh, these are some nice rugs...
Maybe too nice for my roommate and I.
They've got this really nice sparkling, non-alcoholic grape wine here.
My roommate and I are BIG fans.
Non-alcoholic..so like, grap juice?
No!
It's better than grocery store grape juice...more elevated.
The peanut butter ice cream here is so freakin' good.
It's been my go-to for years now.
I'm surprised this jewelry store didn't open up in the mall instead.
Guess it'd be more cost-effective here.
Ah, there's that Pat. He's a swell guy.
You can tell he really loves his job.
How odd... Pat isn't there.
I used to drink an ice-cream milk tea EVERY day when this store first opened.
It... I'm quite sure it's the cause of this gut...

I hear people sometimes buy them and not use them.
Whaaaat?! Really?

Ah, I wonder if George is working the office today...
Hey, there he is!
Ah, I wonder if George is working the office today...
Hmm... Guess he's on his beat.
I try not to drink coffee too much. I feel like it makes my breath stink...
Ah. It's Breezy.
I love the guy, he makes me laugh, but GOD is he a handful.
People are always coming up to me to complain about Breezy...
He usually takes it in stride when I throw him out, though...so I guess I'm thankful for that?
Agh, it's Breezy.
At least I'm off the clock. I wouldn't need to deal with him if he causes trouble.
Hey, it's George!
I know it's silly to get excited to see your roommate. But he's great! So I'm happy to see him wherever.
Hey, it's George!
I know it's silly to get excited to see your roommate. But he's great! So I'm happy to see him wherever.
Okay, I can't do my job if you're pestering me like this... I'm gonna have to tell you to stop.
Sssstop...
STOP!!!
Okay, enough chatter. I'm pooped from my last shift.
Shush, now... Boundaries...
Nrghh...
I don't love that the uniform is white... Stains are so obvious on it...
Coffee stains, soup stains, guac stains...
...Pit stains.

I've got a few 'power poses' up my sleeve too. Very important!
Oh, uhm? You're talking to me?
Are you alright? Is something the matter?
I'm just saying hi...
Oh. Well, hello, then citizen.
Carry...on.
Keep movin'.

Good day.

Believe me when I say we didn't plan to enroll in the academy together. It just so happens that career managers will point you that way when they see if you're big and burly like us.
It's unfair for us cops... I crave a donut and now I'm a punchline to some kinda joke.
There are...worse problems to have...
Okay, yeah, I know- OBVIOUSLY.
Buhh...that pastry shop at 12th Street has the tastiest donuts ever...
Just eat the donut, dude...
I'm trying to maintain a certain image, okay?

So you're complaining there isn't enough crime for your entertainment?
No! Gods, no.
I just want to help if I can. I feel like such a doofus patrolling an area that doesn't really need my presence.
Check out the badge. I polished it reeeaal good.
A lot of free time on your hands, huh?
Polished badge commands respect and emits professionalism. I'm trying to be an exemplary model of an officer!
Unlike George... He loses his badge at least twice a year. It's crazy he still has this job.
Oh. Is that one of your brothers you've mentioned?
No! Hells, no! Why do people keep suggesting that? We don't look alike at all...
Ok, buddy, I appreciate the chit-chat, but I've gotta get back on my beat.
Uh. You can go now. ...dismissed!

Guhh, have been getting some crazy back pains. I oughta get a back brace.

All I would need is grill attached to a set of wheels.
You're willing to quit this job?

And what would that kind of people be?
Oh...I better not say.
You look like someone who knows how to put it DOWN on the grill.
I absolutely am!

At least that's just what I've heard.
Gotta...resist the mall donuts.
Buhh. I'm getting a little sleepy.

At least you get to save money on not needing to buy coffee?
I still get coffee. Pretty regularly. An over the top caramel frappe.
What? Caffeine doesn't work on me, sure, but I still enjoy the taste of it.
Greetings, citizen. Is there a problem..? You've been looking at me awhile now.
No problem, whatsover- just saying hi! I'm Tsuki! A farmer from Mushroom Village.

Can I be of assistance?

'Ello.

Have you been cryin' lately? Just- just kidding.

Oh, relax. I'm "just kidding" too.

Mushroom Village? Haha, that doesn't sound like a real place at all!

Would have been nice if I had an office job instead... I want air conditioning so bad....

I remember you! How's it going?

Going great! And you?
Tell me about it. I'm just excited to get home and fall asleep to informercials.

Sounds like you just don't want to be a cop.
I'd be lying if I said I love the job...but it pays the bills.
...I'm realizing I maybe shouldn't be saying something like that out loud. Pretend I said nothing.

Let us see what I have left.
What is it?
Sure.
Ah. The Sapfira.
This drink is special. I think. I cannot remember. My parents put it on top shelf told me a story about it when I was a little boy.
…I have been afraid to touch it.
Like I could break some sort of old spell holding this place together, you understand?
But that does not matter anymore, does it?
That is all you have to say?
I bet it tastes really good?
I just want a drink!
You have no connection to this place, do you?
I know. I mean, the place. The Raven.
Sigh. You got to experience it while it lasted. And it is a good thing that you do not feel the same way I do about this place.
It is a deep pain. Sentimentality.
…No, Tsuki.
But I’m sure I’ll get to see you guys again.
You guys are my friends.
I think it’s a bar. Pretty cool bar.
...Okay.
…That is good drink.
…That is good drink.
Clementine.
So she can leave for nearest store to get more alcohol?
You cannot control everything in life- you need to live with things that are… not so ideal.
What the hell?!
Who is this?! He’s not…he’s not your… Is he?
This is the guy? He hit you???
Here, take the damn money! Shit!
Whatever. You’re crazy.
Hmmph.
Last time we tried 'spicing' things… we made drink on fire and-
Why you want us to be like other yuppie bar?
What're you guys talking about?
Mmnrgh.
I am not grump.
...Unless?
You say this like it is hard thing to make alcohol. I do not know this mixelogy but I know how to make drink. And people, they drink anything.
Ugh, no need to get uslozhnonnyy over a drink. Give me one hour. I make drink.
Okay. Here it is, I call it ‘Stalker'.
There is personal connection for me with this drink.
When I was just a ditya, I watched an old film from my motherland. Even now, I remember it.
I use liqueur made from blackberry, and some garnish in old style.
Well? Drink?
...Now?
Shit! Bunch of babies, all of you.
What about you, Tsuki? What do you think?
I like that it’s strong?
It’s different…but I think I like it!
Hah! Then I think I have made drink that “represent” bar.
I add ‘Stalker’ to menu.
What do you think? Is like fire in the belly, no?
Ito sold store..? That’s… unexpected.
That is just the way things are.
Like when you threw eggs at mayor?
It was on all news channel, ditya.
I bailed you out.
What like your father-
I am not your father and you are a stupid child for pretending that I am!
We are not family.
Why do you want my approval? You do not have to save bar, and you do not have to go throwing tantrum like a helpless fool!
Business is already bad. You are making it worse with…
Do not say that. Things could be worse.
So!
You think you and Clem would have been good match?
Women are complicated. Like puzzle.
Yes.
Five years, you love this woman.
You are afraid she will not return your affections.
Connection.
Aughh.
You are blind to her… problems. She is not good woman to marry.
I will drink to that.
Q-
Sorry. Yeah, it is quiet in here.
Don’t.
Hey, little Tsuki is here.
Man, it’s quiet in here.
…You know, we have old jukebox. It does not work anymore, but I could fix it.
Are you sure? It’s pre-
Okay. Yes, go ahead. Tools are in backroom.
You know, I have a friend back in Mushroom Village who’s really good with fix-
Just fix jukebox, Leon.
Maybe you should take break. Calm down.
…Leon. No more fixing.
Hey, what are you doi-
He was here before I took over the bar. Friend of my parents.
Alexander. He is gone.
Huh? Gone where?
He was old man. We knew it was coming.
I’m really sorry about all this.
Oh, Ditya, what have you done…
I DO NOT WANT THIS GROBANNOGO MONEY!
I cannot accept it! I am sorry!
You have to leave. I cannot help you this time. This is too much.
It is not worth it, ditya.
I… I do not know.
Tsuki! Do not knock Frank over.
Frank?
It is life. Life happen to ceiling.
Yeah, but just watch the bucket, man.
Groovy.
You won’t find yourself wanting for a musician willing to take any job here in Anchor City.
<i>Oh. Absolutely.
My, my. This is quite the beat-up piano. Does anyone even play this thing?
You wanna jam with us?
<i>Hachi machi… Are Anchorites usually this…dramatic?
This place is sick. Nice find, Caleb.
I still don’t think we need a pianist…but I can’t deny the chops.
<i>‘Bout time…
Mom…
We’ve got some top-quality air there!
Bye, misters!

…and I hadn’t realised I’ve been walking for hours? But I’ve never been around so many tall, tall buildings before! I just wanted to see what’s beyond them! OH! Oh, oh!!! Darn near forgot to mention the highlight of my trip today!
I came across this little joint selling “boba tea”. Ain’t heard of it before, and I had my doubts when I saw them big, fancy straws they hand you- but oh my stars. The taste? It blew my SOCKS off!
Heh. I’m grown up. I came to Anchor City all on my own. Gotta find m-
Hi! My name’s Austin! Where are you from?
I’m a farmer from Mushroom Village!
Woah, you’re a farmer too? I’m a farmer! Though, meemaw and peepaw do most of the work since I can’t really use the machinery and vehicles yet… Peepaw did say he’ll eventually teach…
Oh, dip! I almost forgot my task! I keep getting distracted…
Task? What task? And why are you here, in a bar?
I asked a nice man on the street if he’s seen my mom and he told me she hangs around here when she’s not working and that I was too young or something.
Bad word!
Clementine! Yeap. Is she here?
Woah! So you DO know her?! I have so many questions to ask!
Well… What’s she like?
‘Fun’, huh. Wasn’t…really expecting that.
How do you know her? Do you work with her? Meemaw and Peepaw always said she had an important job in the City so she had to be away.
M-mom? Uhm…
Do you recognize me?
Oh, okay! That all sounds good to me. Thank you again, mister Leon. And you too, mister Tom!
Esteemed citizens of Anchor City, I stand before you today to discuss another ambitious project that has been in the works for years.
l.sp: La noche apenas comienza ¿eh? ¿A dónde te diriges, conejo?

l.en: As you are aware, progress is inevitable, as is change. When you elected me as your Mayor, I promised to change this city for the better- I promised to rejuvenate our streets, to create new job opportunities, to enhance Anchor City’s overall quality of life.

…expedite all this by initiating the Urban Renewal project! This would mean heavily investing in modernizing infrastructure and paving the way for more opportunity and business. The heart of this project will center on 14th Street, extending to the outer terminus-
…about development, progress, and guaranteeing a brighter future for all!
l.sp: Oh, sí, recuerdo ese pueblito... Se rumorea que las cosas han cambiado desde la última vez que estuve ahí...

l.en: Wha-
Ladies and gentlemen, please! Let’s remain calm and civil!
Gragh…! Security! SECURITY!
l.sp: ¡Oh, la juventud! Me pregunto si Yori sigue ahí, vendiendo sus chucherías.

l.en: Please escort…escort that individual away.
l.sp: Bueno, ahora es un buen momento para descansar. ¡Buena suerte en tu viaje!

l.en: You sure are taking your time with my drink there, Tommy.
Heheh. You still keeping track of it?
Such a burden… and not a way to live at all!
Speaking of ridiculous ideals…where’s that nerdy doe friend of yours?
Oh… You need ol’ Easy Breezy to blow away all this gloom? Lift your spirits? Like some kinda court jester?
Oh my… Something must’ve happened.
Ah, ah! Don’t obfuscate, Tomas. I only exercise self-interest, and I want to know what went down here!
So... which one of you pissed her off?
It was you, wasn't it, Clem? Lemme guess… she got mad ‘cuz she didn’t like the way you lived.
Like… a train wreck! An unstoppable train that just wouldn’t hit the brakes.
Hey, I got nothing against train wrecks! They’re my favorite kinda people!
Piano boy? Maybe she had enough of the self-pity and loathing?
Like how many life preservers do people need to toss you, am I right?
Boo. Play with me, man!
Leon... Hmm...
It’s probably not you. You wouldn’t have. Everything you ever had is and was here.
That leaves…
Heheheh… Bingo.
Well. That was fun, but I think I’m gonna bounce now. You guys are kind of in a…mood, and I’m not feeling it. Toodles!
C’mon, lemme at this Stalker drink.
Lady, I woke up in a dumpster and ate pasta from it just two hours ago.
I ain’t gonna find a free drink gross, even from this shithole.
Tommy boy, don’t be like that…
Hey, who’s the new fella?
What's up?
Easy Breezy. Nice to meet ya, Sucky!
